QuestInfo.name: Pity
QuestInfo.0: You could not stand idly by while the whole village ganged up on Bitsie and Edward, now transformed into the snow monster. Hoping the villagers will see reason, you step in to protect the two children.\r\nDefiant in the face of an angry mob, what will become of them?
